sn21.7:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
sn21.7:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā visākho pañcālaputto upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti poriyā vācāya vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpaniyā pariyāpannāya anis sitāya.
sn21.7:2.1: atha kho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena upaṭṭhānasālā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
sn21.7:2.3: ko nu kho bhikkhave upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samut tejeti sampahaṃseti poriyā vācāya vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpaniyā pariyāpannāya anissitāyāti.
sn21.7:2.4: āyasmā bhante visākho pañcālaputto upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti poriyā vācāya vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpaniyā pariyāpannāya anissitāyāti.
sn21.7:3.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ visākhaṃ pañcālaputtaṃ āmantesi
sn21.7:3.3: sādhu kho tvaṃ visākha bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi …pe… atthassa viññāpaniyā pariyāpannāya anissitāyāti.
sn21.7:4.2: idaṃ vatvāna sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā
